rules.title: Domain crate cannot import external frameworks
rules.description: worldwiki-domain must remain pure without dependencies on tauri, tokio, surrealdb, or reqwest.
rules.remediation: Move infrastructure dependencies to ports and adapter traits.

rules.title: Application layer cannot import Tauri
rules.description: worldwiki-application use cases must not depend on tauri::* types.
rules.remediation: Pass UI parameters as clean DTOs into use case methods.

rules.title: Tauri SDK isolated strictly to adapters/tauri
rules.description: Only worldwiki-tauri crate is authorized to import and configure Tauri APIs.
rules.remediation: Move desktop bridge commands into crates/adapters/tauri.

rules.title: MutexGuard held across await point
rules.description: Holding std::sync::MutexGuard across .await point causes Tokio worker starvation and deadlocks.
rules.remediation: Use tokio::sync::Mutex or explicitly drop the guard before .await.

rules.title: Tainted input reached process execution sink
rules.description: Unsanitized IPC arguments cannot reach std::process::Command without explicit validation.
rules.remediation: Sanitize path via validate_safe_path() or annotate function with #[arch_guard(sanitizes)].

rules.title: Logic bloat in Vue SFC script setup
rules.description: Vue components must contain only glue code (props, emits, useFeature calls) under 25-30 lines.
rules.remediation: Extract business logic into use<Component>.ts composable.

rules.title: Direct Tauri IPC import in Vue template
rules.description: Vue components cannot directly call invoke() or listen() from @tauri-apps/api.
rules.remediation: Route data calls through use*.ts -> Store -> API Client.

rules.title: Resource listener without symmetric onUnmounted cleanup
rules.description: Calling listen() or addEventListener() in composables requires symmetrical unlisten in onUnmounted.
rules.remediation: Store unlisten handle and execute it inside onUnmounted(() => { ... }).

rules.title: Zero raw CSS in Vue SFC templates
rules.description: Feature styles must be extracted into dedicated stylesheets in @worldwiki/resources.

rules.title: Mirroring stylesheet taxonomy violation
rules.description: CSS files in @worldwiki/resources must 1-to-1 mirror the component folder structure.
rules.remediation: Place stylesheet into matching styles/features/<feature>/<Component>.css path.

rules.title: Duplicate CSS declaration blocks
rules.description: Identical CSS rule sets repeated across multiple stylesheets should be unified.
rules.remediation: Extract repeated rule set into a shared utility in @worldwiki/resources/base.

rules.title: Hardcoded CSS values and colors
rules.description: Direct hex colors, named colors, raw border-radius and shadows are forbidden.
rules.remediation: Use design tokens: var(--color-...), var(--border-radius-...), var(--glass-...).
